title: Bedroom Standards
description:
Bed-making process (8 steps):
1. Fitted Sheet — Fit the King Fitted Sheet over the mattress. Pull all four corners tight.
2. First Flat Sheet — Lay the King Flat Sheet on the bed. Leave about two finger-widths (2–3 in) of overhang at the headboard.
3. Duvet — Lay the Duvet flat in the center of the bed. Top edge flush with the headboard.
4. Second Flat Sheet — Lay another King Flat Sheet. Align the top edge with the duvet top.
5. Headboard Fold — Fold the excess sheet from Step 2 back over the duvet. About 1 in wide, neat and straight.
6. Tuck Sides & Foot — Tuck all excess material under the mattress. Pull tight, no visible wrinkles.
7. Pillow Dressing — Pillow Protector first, then Pillow Case. Opening faces inward.
8. Pillow Placement — Center pillows at headboard. Symmetrical, equal height.
descriptionZh:
铺床流程（8步）：
1. 铺床笠（King Fitted Sheet）—— 将King Fitted Sheet套在床垫上，四个角全部拉紧，确保没有松脱。
2. 铺第一层平床单（King Flat Sheet）—— 将King Flat Sheet铺在床上，床头位置多留约两根手指宽（约2-3英寸）垂出床垫。
3. 铺被子（Duvet）—— 将Duvet平铺在床中央，被子顶部与床头边缘齐平。
4. 铺第二层平床单（King Flat Sheet）—— 再铺一张King Flat Sheet，床单顶部与Duvet顶部对齐。
5. 做床头翻边—— 将第2步多留出来的床单向上翻折回来，盖住Duvet顶部，翻折宽度约1英寸左右，看起来整齐平直。
6. 收床尾和两侧—— 将床尾及两侧所有多余的床单和被子塞入床垫下，拉紧表面，确保没有明显褶皱。
7. 套枕头—— 先套Pillow Protector（枕芯保护套），再套Pillow Case（枕套），整理平整，枕套开口朝内侧。
8. 摆放枕头—— 将枕头居中放在床头，左右对称，高度一致。

images.altText: Correct: King bed with 4 pillows at 45° angle, duvet flush with headboard, flat sheet folded neatly
images.altTextZh: 正确：特大床4个枕头呈45度角，羽绒被与床头齐平，床单折叠整齐

title: Kitchen Standards

images.altText: Correct: Fully sanitized toilet and bidet, all surfaces disinfected

title: Washbasin 1 Standards (Left)
description: Left washbasin with mirror, soap dispenser, and towel set. Mirror must be streak-free under all lighting conditions. Soap dispenser filled to at least 50%.

title: Washbasin 2 Standards (Right)
description: Right washbasin with mirror, soap dispenser, and towel set. Same standards as Washbasin 1. Confirm both basins are equally clean and fully stocked.
